title: Micro-Probe Full Analysis - Run stats_utils on results.jsonl
abstract: Load micro_probe_t115/results.jsonl, compute spike_flag using tokens_delta, run fitting and thresholds, generate summary to micro_probe_t115/analysis.md.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
sys.path.append('storage/shared')
sys.path.append('storage/shared/meta/anomaly_experiments')

from stats_utils import fit_model, detect_thresholds, generate_summary

def main():
    # Load micro-probe logs
    log_path = 'storage/shared/meta/anomaly_experiments/micro_probe_t115/results.jsonl'
    events_df = pd.read_json(log_path, lines=True)
    
    # Ensure tokens_delta is present
    if 'tokens_delta' not in events_df.columns:
        print("Error: tokens_delta not found")
        return
    
    # Add spike_flag if not present
    if 'spike_flag' not in events_df.columns:
        median = np.median(events_df['tokens_delta'])
        mad = np.median(np.abs(events_df['tokens_delta'] - median))
        events_df['spike_flag'] = events_df['tokens_delta'] > median + 3 * mad
    
    # Add total_writes_so_far if needed (using index as proxy)
    if 'total_writes_so_far' not in events_df.columns:
        events_df['total_writes_so_far'] = range(1, len(events_df) + 1)
    
    # Run analysis
    model = fit_model(events_df)
    thresholds = detect_thresholds(events_df)
    
    # Generate summary
    summary_path = 'storage/shared/meta/anomaly_experiments/micro_probe_t115/analysis.md'
    generate_summary(events_df, model, thresholds, summary_path)
    
    # Print key outputs
    print(f"Model States: {model['states']}")
    print(f"Detected Thresholds: {thresholds}")
    print(f"Summary generated at: {summary_path}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
